subject: [PATCH v3 09/11] mm, swap: add debugfs counters for vswap

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch adds two debugfs counters to track the usage of virtual swap slots in Linux. The 'used' counter tracks the number of pages currently allocated, while the 'alloc_reject' counter tracks the cumulative number of pages that failed to get a vswap slot. This allows for better monitoring and debugging of vswap performance issues.
